The green fill cue is what makes the emoji feel green coded — it is not just 'shape,' it is 'green coded circle-shape moment.'

It is saying 'green coded circle-shape,' which carries a specific design-coded tradition. That is why 🟢 travels especially well on partner list-bullet markers, list-marker reveals, and any context where the sender wants the message to land with green energy.
